summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of common shares and pre-funded warrants. The company offers 1,969,444 common shares at $0.90/share and 3,975,000 pre-funded warrants (each exercisable for one share at $0.00001). The offering is not a special situation but a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation or external advisor is disclosed beyond dealer-manager D. Boral Capital LLC. The securities are not escrowed; delivery is DVP. The closing price on Nasdaq was $1.86. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. This filing is a standard follow-on offering and does not constitute a special situation.
